fields.field: AC center-tap to 75-ohm Bob Smith branch bypass. Use stocked KEMET C0805C223K1RACTU 22nF 100V X7R 10% 0805, maximum height 0.88 mm, same nominal value, voltage rating, tolerance, host and pins as incumbent Murata. Power owner accepts role equivalence with no required hard DC-biased capacitance floor. This maintains the 100V component rating; it does not assert system galvanic isolation. The selected input TVS/enclosure/transient envelope and physical EMI/link behavior remain full-stage checks. Place on B at the reviewed compact back-side center-tap/Bob Smith bank; preserve literal VC-to-cap-to75ohm-toBS_STAR topology. The AC branch provides no DC input-current credit. Final CT-force, source, shield/return and actual six-layer geometry remain mandatory.

fields.field: True reverse-blocking adjustable OV cutoff eFuse; PGTH senses own INPUT, not shared output. PoE overload latchoff; restart requires power removal. MP4583 PG holds UV through1k untilconvertergood;1u UVRC releaseshardwareafteroutputestablished. 10n100V/100ohm dVdt limits downstreambank charging; normalreverseblock/OCP/OV/OTP remain. PG low on converterfault dischargesUVcap; no firmware startup dependency. PG3 intentionally unused after removal of input-branch status comparators. Original PGTH4 divider remains. Actual UV/OV/current/reverse/default and converter-PG-to-UV interlocks unchanged; U21.PG is indication only, not a new inhibit authority.

OVLO recoverable, overcurrent/OTP volatilelatch clearsENbelow.45V orVIN0. NewITIMER andDVDT100ohm; actualPG fullyenhancedFET plus outputthreshold. fields.field: Manual SW2 asserts FULL_CARD_POWER_OFF# LOW through U16; it does not disconnect the protected 3.7V rail. For orderly shutdown send AT+CFUN=0 and wait for OK before assertion, then hold at least1s before external VCC removal (RM520N Hardware Design V1.3 Table11 Tpd minimum900ms). Release is subject to actual protected-PG/supervisor qualification. Independent OOB rail power-cycle must hold jointEN LOW>=5s AND confirm actualOUT<100mV before re-enabling; do not use the FCPO button hold as discharge proof. Sudden source loss and assembled shutdown/boot waveforms remain first-prototype gates.

fields.field: Genuine ST USBLC6-2P6 SOT-666, DS4260 Rev7. Symmetric paired channels reassigned together: IO1 pins1/6 carry PORT_DP/PROTECT_DP and IO2 pins3/4 carry PORT_DN/PROTECT_DN; pin2 GND, pin5 VBUS_C. Internal channel metal is common only within each literal pair, never across DP/DN. 3.5pF max, 150nA max 25C leakage, IEC 8kV contact/15kV air. Preserve FSUSB42 ownership and modem-powered TMUX1511 data/reset isolation. Authentic 1.7x1.7x0.62mm max body and Figure21 recommended lands. No change to USB session/ownership/reset semantics.

property.name: Note
property.value: Genuine ST USBLC6-2P6 SOT-666, DS4260 Rev7. Symmetric paired channels reassigned together: IO1 pins1/6 carry PORT_DP/PROTECT_DP and IO2 pins3/4 carry PORT_DN/PROTECT_DN; pin2 GND, pin5 VBUS_C. Internal channel metal is common only within each literal pair, never across DP/DN. 3.5pF max, 150nA max 25C leakage, IEC 8kV contact/15kV air. Preserve FSUSB42 ownership and modem-powered TMUX1511 data/reset isolation. Authentic 1.7x1.7x0.62mm max body and Figure21 recommended lands. No change to USB session/ownership/reset semantics.

fields.field: TMUX1511 PW14: channels1/2 retain paired USB between modem and ownership mux, gated by USB_GATE; channel3 retains hardware RM520 RESET67 sink through S3 GND/D3 RESET and OOB_MODEM_RESET. Channel4 isolates the modem eFuse current monitor from ESP32 GPIO9 when independent AON is not power-good: S4 pin12=MODEM_IMON_TO_ISOLATOR, D4 pin11=OOB_ADC_MODEM_CURRENT, SEL4 pin13=AON_PG; VDD14 remains protected V3V7. Current-native footprint remains F12.6,79.0/90 degrees. R756 is the fitted 1M ILM observer branch; R757 is the fitted MCU-side 100k pull-down. The S4 ordinary tented 0.55/0.20 receiver at12.3,74.3 and D4 literal Type7 0.40/0.15 terminal receiver preserve existing USB/reset copper and the actual source-reference areas. No ADC capacitor is placed directly on raw ILM. Published powered-off VDD0 leakage is not a claim for arbitrary partial VDD. The engineering transfer tolerance, partial-rail states, powered-off injection, 150ms settling, calibration, ramp/fault and firmware commissioning gates remain in the companion power qualification packet.

The defined installation uses regulated nonisolated 50.4V maximum and a 0..70C component environment. Normal input RMS and cable/CT temperature limits are governed by the final whole-board power policy and its waveform contract; the limited fault and impulse envelopes are separate, not continuous ratings. Retain loaded-link, DC imbalance/bias, ripple, temperature-rise and fault first-article verification. No IEEE PoE/system-isolation or arbitrary-imbalance OCL guarantee is inferred. Final F78.6,85/0 uses the primary 24-land pattern and both-side logical channel reversals, preserving all eight standard J1 pin polarities without a PHY register swap. fields.field: Hardware default-autostart remains POWER_OK & RUN. Former CURRENT_OK input3 is tied directly to this gate V3V3, not fault status; same authentic G11 DBV package. MODEM_EN_ALLOWED drives BOTH MP2386 EN11 and TPS259474LRPWR EN1. PG/FLT must not feed EN or cause automatic latch-clearing. RUN remains external pull-high with MCU open-drain inhibit; main-domain supply loss yields passive EN LOW. Any actual input/rail power loss can rearm the volatile eFuse latch; no AON-retained fault-memory claim. The new compact eFuse PG remains observation/start qualification only; it never drives EN. Blank/reset MCU leaves Q740 gate LOW via R741, so R752 pulls RUN HIGH and hardware starts the modem after main POWER_OK. U16 CT is hardware programmed by R118=100k to guarantee at least180ms protected PG/start qualification before FCPO release; independent OOB open-drain RUN inhibit and MR assertion retain hard-off recovery.

NoWiFi/Bluetooth RF initialization;LNA_IN is NC. Supply pins stay powered;VDD_SPI pin29 is locally decoupled RTC output and is not directly shorted to AON. Physical51/GPIO45 drives activeHIGH radio RESET_ASSERT through Q746;physical52/GPIO46 drives RXEN through U802. Both are current v2.2 input/output strapping GPIOs with existing external10k R784/R566 pulldowns; separateR815/R816 are retired. LOW through3ms after CHIP_PU rising preserves3.3V VDD_SPI and joint-download boot whenGPIO0LOW. InternalweakPD assists; no guaranteed typical45k resistor assumption. Default/reset RUN on physical47/GPIO41 remainsLOW, keepsradioOFF and OE disabled. GPIO45/46 must remain inputs withoutpull-up through3ms strap hold, then initializedLOW beforeRUN; no eFuse burn. FormerRXENGPIO42/physical48 remains NC. Modem OFF is now GPIO17/physical23 through existing1k R740 and existing10k R741 to Q740 gate; GPIO6/physical11 is NC. GPIO17 is reset input-enabled and has the same documented typicalLOW60us power-up glitch as formerGPIO6; no strap/JTAG/in-package flash conflict. Firmware reserves physical23 as activeHIGH modemOFF, initializesLOW before output enable, and never assigns UART1TX to this pin. MCU reset/blank startup still allows hardware autostart through unchanged defaultLOW R741; recovery drivesOFFHIGH>=5s and confirms modemrail<100mV before release. Independent MODEM_RESET GPIO7/physical12 and independent hardware qualified modemRUN remain unchanged. A new .40/.15 Type7 pole at72.6,9.3 is the only under-U800 OFF hole; receiver68.8,33.1 is ordinary .45/.20, and four routed .40/.15 ordinary transition holes stay outside all primary bodies. Exact factory profile required for each hole, not generic .20drill fabrication. All original power/ground/source roles are separately verified after native refill. Physical43/GPIO38 remains FAULTinput; physical24/GPIO18 remainsunused due documentedtypical high glitch. PreserveUART0 recovery49/50 and the exact clock/DIO/BUSY pins17/21/22. Radio uses lowest useful GPIO drive, initial1MHz SPI, qualified PG and independent hardware OE/RUN gating. GPIO21/physical27 requests internalUSB only after initializationLOW; physical36 observes externalVBUS. No undocumentedM2UART. Physical14/GPIO9ADC1_CH8 remains analog current observation withoutdigitaldrive orpull. Recovery holds modemOFF>=5s, confirmsrail<100mV before restart; blankMCU autostart remainshardware-backed. New exact .40/.15 Type7 U800 escape holes require both faces planar capped with no proud copper and the literal factory mask/flatness profile; all other transition holes use explicit ordinary tenting and no fill/cap. Low-rate reset/RXEN F/In2/In3/B routes guard actual current571 XTAL three-height return field and all high-current power sheets. A deliberate4.6223mm F0.4 AON source bridge joins Fentry73.5,14.6 through explicitly qualifiedType7pole73.525,14.575 and enlarged ordinary75.49,18.4 source pole to restore physical46/C805 input; exact source/return/125C sensitivity is separately proved. U749 output2 is also explicitly NC while its input6 remains GND. Firmware must not assign GPIO35 to the retired OOB_CURRENT_OK function or interpret that obsolete signal as a current fault. MAIN_OK, MODEM_PG, coarsecurrentADC, actualrailADC and independentSTOP/RESET remain unchanged. GPIO9 ADC1CH8 uses combinedILM guarded1M/100k pluslocal100nC989. Configure calibratedATTEN0, WiFiOFF duringsampling, noGPIOdrive/pulls; >=150ms settle afterisolationenable/railstartup, discardfirstconversion andaverage. Report coarsecalibratedloadbins with±5mV25C primaryADC plusgain/leakage/temperatureuncertainty, neverzero=currentOFF. ActualPG andrailADC plusindependentSTOP/RESETremainrecoveryauthority. I2C1446 source escape: SDA now physical19/GPIO14, former physical41/GPIO36 NC; SCL remains physical42/GPIO37. GPIO14 Table2-1 AtReset field blank, AfterReset IE; no internal-pull claim. Initialize SDA/SCL high latch before output enable, input/output open-drain through GPIO matrix, external2.49k pulls only,100kHz; bounded bus errors/stale state UNKNOWN. Every ADC/control/recovery pin and GPIO21 REQUEST reset correction are retained. One sealed Type7 own-U800 source pole and eleven ordinary tented public150um jobs require explicit manufacturer acceptance; first-board rise-time and stuck-bus/recovery checks required. Local observer1498: physical38/GPIO33 and physical39/GPIO34 are now NC; MAIN_OK/MODEM_PG status is read from local U840 I2C0x41 P0/P1 via retained unidirectional U749 outputs. fields.field: Local status-only NCA9536DQJ I2C observer, fixed address 0x41 distinct from TMP102 0x48. P0 observes buffered U749 pin7 MAIN_OK and P1 buffered U749 pin5 MODEM_PG through 1k series resistors. U749 remains unidirectional: no expander state drives raw POWER_OK/PG or hardware qualification/recovery. All four ports remain inputs with internal pullups enabled; no P3 interrupt or output control. Default LOW load is bounded to 100uA per used port on the common AON supply. Bus NACK, stuck, timeout or stale data means UNKNOWN, never GOOD. Rail/current ADC and independent STOP/RESET/autostart remain bus independent. The final joined-revision source/routing/GND/reference receipts govern the assembled revision. Historical observer1539/pullup1545 static sink/rise/capacitance sensitivity screens remain bounded qualification provenance, not a guaranteed measured bus capacitance. Retain sealed-flat-cap/CAM and first-article bus capacitance, VOL, rise, supply ramp, temperature, leakage and failure-injection measurements; MCU/TMP102 capacitances are typical-only inputs, not guaranteed whole-board bus capacitance.
